title: Beat the Blitz
concept: Pick and roll vs blitz: the screener short-rolls, catches the outlet, and plays 4 on 3. Read the weak-side helper.
possession: original E2A 5v5, canonical file tactical/iq02/basketball_iq_02_blitz_short_roll.json (not a reconstruction of any real possession)

options.label: Drive
options.why: X4 has stepped into the paint, on the line to the rim

options.label: Corner
options.why: X3 stayed home in the corner

options.label: Cut
options.why: X4 left O4 to stop the big; O4 cuts behind him at 45 degrees

teaching_points: Against two on the ball, the ball handler outlets EARLY, before the trap closes.
The screener's short roll to the nail creates a 4 on 3 behind the trap.
The big reads the HELP, not the ball: who left whom?
When the weak-side helper steps into the paint, the space behind him is the target: cut at 45 degrees behind him.
Pass around the helper (here: a bounce pass under his arms).
lesson_line: Read the help. Attack the space it leaves.
checks_for_understanding: Who is the defender to watch after the short-roll catch?
Why is the corner pass wrong in THIS possession?
What would change if X3 rotated instead of X4?
drills_suggested: 45-degree cut timing vs a sinking helper

future_variants_metadata_only.idea: X3 rotates from the corner instead of X4. Needs its own keyframes and validation.
Nobody steps into the paint. Needs its own keyframes and validation.
